policy.lead_fit_automation_scope: only deterministic bounded ProspectQualifications using the Leads Customer Potential contract
policy.mailcopy_automation_scope: only deterministic LeadPromo prepare rows for A-qualified and ContactCandidates.ready prospects; status remains prepared/manual_review
policy.private_postal_config_scope: physical postal address is loaded from the service-account-readable private Webactueel Outreach Config Sheet, masked before GITHUB_ENV export and not read from a plaintext repository variable

boundaries: US prioritized first, NL second, then configured remaining sources
directory provider infrastructure and obvious institutional/navigation candidates rejected
manufacturing directory candidates require manufacturing/industrial official-site self-description
directory_sitemap follows at most 3 same-host sitemap-index children
no lead score or qualification decision

prospect_qualification.score_contract: ICP 0-3 + one primary evidence-bound website opportunity 0-3 + active signal 0-2 + offer fit 0-2; A=8-10, B=6-7, C=0-5
boundaries: bounded aged or explicit rechecks only
one primary opportunity severity is scored rather than summing generic gaps
fact and idea are bound to official-page evidence
agency/provider and self targets fail closed
no guessed or constructed email addresses

zero_touch_prepare.flow: prospect_discovery -> prospect_candidate_sanitizer -> prospect_signal_discovery -> prospect_qualification -> contact_enrichment -> prospect_intelligence -> private_outreach_config -> outreach_prepare
boundaries: only A-qualified plus ContactCandidates.ready can become prepared copy
stale automated prepared rows no longer A+ready reconcile to manual_review
compliance_basis remains blank until independently evidenced
US prepare copy uses masked private-sheet postal address and commercial-message label

sender_readiness.provider_managed_rule: when required SPF token is include:spf.mijn.host and SPF is green, absence of one fixed egress IP is represented as provider_managed; this is not per-IP reputation or global placement proof

outreach_delivery.private_config: physical postal address loaded from private Config Sheet and masked before GITHUB_ENV export
outreach_delivery.live_gate: sender_readiness -> website target/evidence -> LeadPromo copy -> compliance -> SMTP
boundaries: Leads policy owns qualification/copy/compliance contracts; repository automation may execute bounded qualification and prepare-only copy but never grants compliance or send permission
live sender readiness gate runs before target/evidence/copy/compliance/SMTP
approved rows require website_scan JSON with same-domain evidence_url and exact idea present in body
NL targets are allowed but still require the normal NL/EER compliance basis
webactueel.nl and all subdomains remain blocked
official homepage is rechecked against agency/provider terms before SMTP
US targets require private-config physical postal address plus commercial-message identification
UK unsolicited route requires verified corporate subscriber metadata and clear Ltd/Limited/LLP/PLC company form
controlled English LeadPromo copy is allowed for international targets without mixing CTA/opt-out/signature languages

scanner_routing.why_it_exists: Levert reproduceerbaar desktop/mobile browserbewijs voor expliciete audits of een specifiek technisch bewijs-gat dat Leads na de lichte officiële-sitecheck heeft vastgesteld.
use_when: de gebruiker expliciet een website-audit vraagt
de gebruiker expliciet een technische scan of rescan vraagt
Leads heeft een specifiek technisch bewijs-gat dat niet eenvoudiger bewezen kan worden

leads_handoff.purpose: normalize audit evidence for Leads readback

prospect_discovery.purpose: bounded approved-source international company/domain discovery with target-fill, country/agency policy, source semantics, observation provenance and historical source-run evidence

prospect_target_policy.purpose: prioritize US first, NL second, then remaining sources; exclude webactueel.nl/subdomains and multilingual agency/provider competitors

prospect_source_semantics.purpose: reject provider-self/institutional directory noise and manufacturing-category drift before qualification

directory_sitemap_adapter.purpose: consume bounded public directory sitemap/urlset sources and follow same-host profile pages to official company domains

prospect_intelligence.purpose: derive entity/freshness, source-performance, evidence-graph and lookalike views from evidence-bound Sheet state

prospect_signal_discovery.purpose: collect bounded official-site hiring and WordPress/WooCommerce evidence for existing candidates

prospect_qualification.purpose: deterministically apply bounded Customer Potential to official-site evidence and preserve the audit record in ProspectQualifications

contact_enrichment.purpose: bounded official-site business-email lookup for qualified prospects

private_outreach_config.purpose: load physical postal address from private service-account-readable Sheet, mask it, and export it only to the current job environment

outreach_prepare.purpose: generate deterministic LeadPromo prepare-only copy from A qualification plus ready official-site contact and reconcile stale automated prepared rows fail-closed

zero_touch_prepare.purpose: weekday bounded discovery-to-prepared-queue orchestration without mailbox credentials or SMTP

mailbox_draft.purpose: append and verify one self-addressed concept through mijn.host IMAP

outreach_target_evidence.purpose: recheck approved targets, require same-domain website_scan evidence and enforce international target/compliance metadata before copy and SMTP

outreach_transport.purpose: preflight, SMTP/IMAP, sequences, suppression and reporting
